plan.reason: The first exact decomposition locates most reversal variance discrepancy in carried RC response, while most mean discrepancy is already in construction-versus-heldout populations.
plan.selection: Both prefixes, all original construction/heldout populations and the same four regenerated model batches; only the20second carried response in the10+10second reversal
plan.method: Exact product decomposition r_i*F_i about common construction means: amplitude term, rate-gain term and their centered product. Preserve all covariances and the remaining voltage as a fourth group. No fits or model changes.
plan.interpretation: Coordinate-dependent algebraic attribution; identifies response-moment deficits without proving which original conditional caused them. Construction anchors are used only for diagnostics.
